method: Fresh structural contract review of 19 test files: test declarations, assertions, branches, setup/cleanup and side-effect calls extracted from the complete TypeScript AST, followed by complete source review of extension-mcp-drafts and mcp-oauth, and full high-risk branch/draft/unknown-receipt and MCP ABA/unmount test bodies. Checked real Api versus mocked transport boundary, explicit action counts, foreign owner rejection, storage secrecy, cleanup and Vitest restoreMocks configuration. This is static test-contract review, not full-suite execution and not a claim to have read every test-body line in all 19 files. No prior audit conclusion reused.
